assumptions: Unconfoundedness: given observed covariates, treatment is independent of potential outcomes. Untestable; the U edges in the DAG are exactly what it rules out.
Overlap: every covariate profile has a chance of both treatment and comparison. Checked by propensity distribution and weight diagnostics; weak for PSID.
SUTVA / consistency: no interference between participants and one version of treatment.
Correct specification: the outcome and propensity models are approximations; results are sensitive to them.
The experiment supports a causal reading only for the NSW volunteer population (external validity not established).

nodes.label: age, education, race, marital status, no-degree

dag.note: In the experiment T is randomized (no incoming edges). In the PSID comparison T is selection: the U edges are the threat to the observational estimators.

ipw_att.name: Inverse-probability weighting
ipw_att.note: Correct only if the propensity model is right; with weak overlap a handful of comparison units carry most of the weight (see effective controls).
ipw_att.short: reweight comparison units by the odds of looking like a treated unit (propensity score)

naive.name: Naive difference in means
naive.note: Unbiased only if treatment is as good as random with no covariates (true in the NSW experiment, not for PSID); index 0 is then read without conditioning.
naive.short: treated mean minus comparison mean, no adjustment

ols_coef.name: OLS with covariates
ols_coef.note: Also assumes one constant effect for everyone and linear covariate effects; extrapolates silently where groups do not overlap.
ols_coef.short: coefficient on treatment in a linear model of 1978 earnings on covariates

ra_att.name: Regression adjustment
ra_att.note: Relies on the comparison-group model being right for the treated covariates; leans on extrapolation when overlap is weak.
ra_att.short: predict treated units' earnings without training from a model fitted on comparison units

spec.benchmark: experimental difference in means on the NSW (Dehejia-Wahba) randomized sample
spec.bootstrap: 500 resamples, numpy PCG64 seed 20261011, percentile CI
spec.data_terms: NBER nsw_dw.dta and psid_controls.dta, attributable non-commercial use (CC by NC); derived results only; no row-level data published
spec.scope: NSW results are precomputed (microdata is not shipped). The browser reruns the estimators on the SYNTHETIC environment, with parity vectors.

synthetic.dgp: x1,x2 ~ N(0,1); treated if uniform < sigmoid(gamma (0.8 x1 + 0.6 x2)); y = tau t + 2 x1 + 1.5 x2 + N(0,1); tau = 1
